dateRule: Inclusive ISO civil-date intervals. Look up the selected-year July 1 date, not the source record start year. Apply only after the record itself passes its native startDate/endDate validity test.
preservation: Keep native r.name, source properties, sourceIndex, code, geometry and archive date ranges unchanged. Preserve and show the original umbrella source name in the record/source details. Do not use these aliases as entity bindings.

russianAbdication.supports: Nicholas II abdicated on 15 March 1917 (Gregorian date).

ussrFormation.title: Law Library of Congress — Treaty on the Creation of the Soviet Union
ussrFormation.supports: Union treaty adopted on 30 December 1922; the USSR did not immediately succeed the imperial regime.

ussrDissolution.supports: Formal dissolution of the USSR on 26 December 1991.

ottomanEnd.title: Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs — diplomatic history of the Bern legation
ottomanEnd.supports: Sultanate abolished on 1 November 1922; transition to the Republic proclaimed 29 October 1923. PDF zero-based page 35.

italianUnification.title: Italian Ministry of Culture — Unification Day
italianUnification.supports: Victor Emmanuel II became King of Italy on 17 March 1861, before the archive begins in 1886.

germanUnification.title: U.S. Office of the Historian — Germany
germanUnification.supports: German Empire established 18 January 1871; accreditation changed from Prussia to the German Empire before the archive begins.

yugoslav1929.title: Museum of Yugoslavia — historical timeline
yugoslav1929.supports: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes renamed Kingdom of Yugoslavia on 3 October 1929.

serbiaMontenegro.title: United Nations Digital Library — Serbia and Montenegro authority record
serbiaMontenegro.supports: Name period 4 February 2003–2 June 2006; Yugoslavia renamed on 4 February 2003.

serbiaContinuation.title: United Nations — Serbia state file
serbiaContinuation.supports: Serbia continued State Union membership on the basis of the declaration of independence of Montenegro on 3 June 2006.
